title: Five new books from outside the 66
summary: Five more books from outside the 66 now have a Plain English Translation, with study notes, manuscript differences and chapter pages: the Prayer of Manasseh and Psalm 151, which Orthodox churches read as Scripture; 4 Maccabees, printed in an appendix to the Greek Orthodox Bible; Jubilees, Scripture for the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church; and the Psalms of Solomon, which are in no church's Bible. Eleven new topic pages come with them, among them the Dead Sea Scrolls, the Heavenly Tablets and the Maccabean Martyrs.
